<!-- pr-reviewer: f0168d0f6d2f795f805064641403682ca2d4c4a4 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blocking items.

- The helper uses Cargo's compile-time temporary root.
- Each call reserves a separate directory with exclusive creation. Existing directories remain intact.
- The two new tests check directory separation and preservation of output from another run.
- The decision record explains the change and the alternatives.

Local results against upstream/main at af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824:

The trial merge reported that the branch was already up to date. The working tree stayed unchanged.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run | Passed; inspected the test plan |
| cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run | Passed; all motion test targets built |
| shape_masks | 13 passed |
| adaptive_hsm | 2 passed; 5 ignored |
| trochoid_slot | 12 passed |
| cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings | Passed |
| git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD | Passed |

Only these three integration suites import the changed shared helper. All their active tests passed.
The original shape_mask_catches_overcut_and_writes_diff_png test passed.

This change affects test output paths only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.
No goldens moved. No UI files changed. Safety mutation tests do not apply; I did not run mutations.
Windows, macOS, and separate concurrent processes were not tested.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
